project_type: Next.js 16.3.1 App Router with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: npm scripts (next build), no npm install available in sandbox
test_framework: Playwright (node tests/full-flow.mjs) - requires running dev server + Gemini API key
test_command: Cannot run full Playwright tests (requires dev server + API key). Use TypeScript compilation check: npx tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. No npm install needed or possible (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no external fetches. Only pre-installed dependencies and GitHub access. lucide-react is already installed. Cannot add new icon libraries.
contribution_requirements: README says: No emojis, no vibe-coded UI, a minimal professional product surface. AGENTS.md references Next.js 16 breaking changes - check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ if needed.
key_patterns: Components use lucide-react icons exclusively. Shared UI components in src/components/ui.tsx (Button, Card, Input, Textarea, Logo, Field, Badge). CSS variables for theming in globals.css. motion/react for animations.
directory_structure: src/app/ has route pages (page.tsx, signin/, onboarding/, parent/, child/, api/). src/components/ has shared UI. src/lib/ has hooks and utilities.
